chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) forbade adding to the grave soil that had not been taken out from it.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the soil used to cover a grave in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of using native soil for grave covering to maintain simplicity and avoid extravagance, a key distinction in Shia fiqh regarding burial rites. It specifically prohibits adding foreign earth or clay that has not been excavated from the grave pit itself, reflecting the Prophet's emphasis on modesty in death practices. This ruling is often cited by scholars to discourage the construction of elaborate mounds or the use of imported materials for grave markers.
